alphabet.blurb: Put the letters in their places in the alphabet — all twenty-six of them
alphabet.intro: The letters of the alphabet stand one after another, always in the same order. A few letters have gone missing! Drag each one to its place.

bubbles.blurb: Pop the bubbles in order: the alphabet and words
bubbles.intro: Letters are hiding in the soap bubbles! Pop them in order — the way they stand in the alphabet.

chain.blurb: Join words: the first letter, halves of a word, meaning
chain.intro: Every word begins with some letter. Join the word with its first letter!

rhymes.blurb: Find words that sound alike: cat — hat
rhymes.intro: Some words end in the same way, as if they were singing together: cat — hat. That is a rhyme! Find the rhyme for every word.

sentences.blurb: Make a sentence out of words — from two to five
sentences.intro: The words have scattered! Put them in order to make a sentence. The first word is written with a capital letter, and there is a period at the end.

alphabet.blurb: {name}: put the letters in their places in the alphabet
alphabet.intro: We are learning the {name} alphabet! Its letters stand one after another, always in the same order. A few letters have gone missing — drag each one to its place.

bubbles.blurb: {name}: pop the bubbles — the alphabet and words
bubbles.intro: We are learning {name}! There are {name} letters in the bubbles. Pop them in order, as in the {name} alphabet. Tap the speaker to hear a letter.

chain.blurb: {name}: join words with letters and with one another
chain.intro: We are learning {name} words! Join every word with the letter it begins with. Tap the speaker to hear the word.

rhymes.intro: {name} has rhymes too — words that sound alike at the end. Tap the speakers, listen to the words and join the ones that rhyme.

sentences.blurb: {name}: make a sentence out of words
sentences.intro: We are making sentences in {name}! Put the words in order. The first word is written with a capital letter, and there is a period at the end.

title: Language

stage.1: Now there are no clues in the empty squares. Remember which letter comes after which!
stage.2: The table has grown: now it has three rows of letters.
stage.3: Now all the letters are in place — but two of them have swapped places. Find one of them and tap it!
stage.4: Here is the whole {p}alphabet! Put all the missing letters in their places.
stage.5: Now there are syllables in the bubbles. Pop them in order to make a word!
stage.6: Now we put {p} words together from syllables. Pop the syllables in the order they stand in the word!
stage.7: Now we put short {p}words together. Pop the letters in the order they stand in the word!
stage.8: And now we spell words from single letters. Pop letter after letter!
stage.9: The words are getting longer. Pop letter after letter — from left to right!
stage.10: Now the word is not written — listen to it and spell it yourself. Careful: there are extra letters among the bubbles!
stage.11: Careful: there are extra letters among the bubbles now. They do not pop!
stage.12: Now we join two words that begin with the same letter.
stage.13: The word has fallen into two halves! Find the ending for every beginning.
stage.14: Now we look for words that belong together in meaning: what goes with what?
stage.15: The sentences are getting longer: now they have three words.
stage.16: And now — real big sentences of four and five words!

order: In the alphabet the letter “{a}” comes before the letter “{b}.”
swapAsk: Two {p}letters have swapped places. Tap a letter that is not in its own place.

swapHint.2: Sing the {p} alphabet in order. The two letters that swapped places are blinking.

after: After the letter “{prev}” in the alphabet comes the letter “{letter}.”
before: Before the letter “{next}” in the alphabet comes the letter “{letter}.”

fillAsk.1: Put the whole {p}alphabet together: put every letter in its place.
fillAsk.2: Put the {p}letter in its place in the alphabet.
fillAsk.3: Put the {p}letters in their places in the alphabet.

fillHint.2: Remember the {p} alphabet. The place for the next letter is blinking, and there are clues in the empty squares.

runAsk.1: Pop the letters in alphabet order: from {from} to {to}.
runAsk.2: Pop the {p} letters in alphabet order — from the first to the last.

runHint.2: Remember the {p} alphabet. The bubble you need is blinking.

partsAsk.2: Put the {p} word together from {p2}. It is written under the picture.

partsHint.1: The word “{word}” goes together like this: {parts}.
partsHint.2: Look at the word under the picture and pop the {p} from left to right.

spellAsk.1: Listen to the word and spell it from the letters.
spellAsk.2: Spell the word from the letters: {word}.
spellAsk.3: Listen to the {p} word and spell it from the letters.
spellAsk.4: Spell the {p} word from the letters. It is written under the picture.

spellHint.1: Say the word slowly: {word}. Its letters: {letters}.
spellHint.2: Tap the speaker by the picture, listen to the word again and pop the letters from left to right. The extra letters do not pop.
spellHint.3: Look at the word under the picture and pop the letters from left to right. The extra letters do not pop.

firstAsk.1: Join every word with the letter it begins with.
firstAsk.2: Join every {p} word with its first letter.

firstHint.1: Say the word out loud and listen to the first sound. “{word}” begins with the letter “{letter}.”
firstHint.2: Look which letter every word begins with.

sameAsk: Join the {p}words that begin with the same letter.

sameHint.1: “{a}” and “{b}” begin with the same letter — “{letter}.”
sameHint.2: Compare the first letters of the words: in a pair they are the same.

halfAsk: Join the beginning of each {p}word with its ending.

halfHint.1: Look at the picture: it is “{head}{tail}.” The word begins with “{head}.”
halfHint.2: Tap the speaker by the picture, listen to the word and find its beginning.

assocAsk: Join the {p}words that belong together in meaning.

assocHint.2: Tap the speaker to hear the word. Look for what goes with it.

rhymeAsk: Find the pairs of {p}words that rhyme.

rhymeHint.1: Words rhyme when they sound the same at the end: “{a}” — “{b}.”
rhymeHint.2: Tap the speakers and listen: words that rhyme sound the same at the end.

sentenceAsk: Put the {p}words in order to make a sentence.

sentenceHint.1: A sentence begins with a word with a capital letter: “{first}.” The last word has a period.
sentenceHint.2: A sentence begins with a word with a capital letter and ends with a word with a period.

alphabet.label: Alphabet
alphabet.blurb: Англійська: постав літери на свої місця в абетці
alphabet.intro: Вчимо англійську абетку! Літери в ній стоять одна за одною, завжди в тому самому порядку. Кілька літер загубилося — перетягни кожну на її місце.

bubbles.label: Bubble Pop
bubbles.blurb: Англійська: лопай бульбашки — абетка і слова з літер
bubbles.intro: Вчимо англійську! У бульбашках — англійські літери. Лопай їх по порядку, як в англійській абетці. Натисни на динамік, щоб почути літеру.

chain.label: Word Chain
chain.blurb: Англійська: з’єднуй слова з літерами та між собою
chain.intro: Вчимо англійські слова! З’єднай кожне слово з літерою, на яку воно починається. Натисни на динамік, щоб почути слово.

rhymes.label: Rhyme Matcher
rhymes.intro: В англійській мові теж є рими — слова, які звучать схоже наприкінці. Натискай на динаміки, слухай слова і з’єднуй ті, що римуються.

sentences.label: Sentence Builder
sentences.intro: Складаємо речення англійською! Постав слова по порядку. Перше слово пишеться з великої літери, а в кінці стоїть крапка.
